paite: Pilna akikou in, theihsiamna in a-aw asuah kei maw?
heading: Pilna Phatna
english: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

paite: Lampi a mun sangte tung ah, lampite kisutna ah adingh a;
english: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

paite: kongpite biang ah, khopi lutna ah, kongkhakte apailutna ah, nakpi in akikou hi.
english: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

paite: Noute, aw mite, ka sam; huan ka aw mite tapa kiang ah ahi.
english: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

paite: Aw nou mimawlte, kivensiamna theisiam un; nou mihaite, lungtang theisiam nei un.
english: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

paite: Za un, thil hoihpente gen ding ka hi ngal a; huan ka mukte honna thil dikte ahi ding hi.
english: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

paite: Ka kam in thutak gen ding ahi ngal a; gitlouhna ka muk a ding in akihhuai hi.
english: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

paite: Ka kam a thute teng diktatna ah a-om; huaite ah bangmah diklou a-om kei hi.
english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

paite: Atheisiam kuapeuh a ding in akichian a, theihna mu amaute a ding in adik hi.
english: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

paite: Ka hilhna sang unla, dangka hilou in; dangka-eng hoihpen sang in theihna.
english: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

paite: Rubi suang sang in pilna ahoihzaw hi; huan deihhuai thilte tengteng huai toh tehpih theih ahi kei uh.
english: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

paite: Kei, pilna, kivensiamna toh ka tengkhawm a, theihna leh theihkakna ka mu hi.
english: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

paite: TOUPA kihtak a gilou huat ding ahi; kisaktheihna leh, ki-otsakna, gilou lampi leh kam hoih lou, ka hua hi.
english: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

paite: Thupha kei a ahi, theihna hoih; theihsiamna leh hatna ka nei hi.
english: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

paite: Kei ziak in kumpipate'n vai ahawm ua, lalte'n dikna thu apia uh.
english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

paite: Kei ziak in lalte'n vai ahawm ua, miliante leh lei a vaihawmte tengteng in.
english: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

paite: Kei hon itte amau ka it a; kuapeuh hon zong in hon mu hi.
english: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

paite: Hauhna leh zahna ka kiang ah a-om; ahi, sawt daih hauhna leh diktatna toh.
english: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

paite: Ka gah dangka-eng sang in ahoihzaw, ahi, dangka-eng hoih sang in; ka sum muhna dangka hoihpen sang in.
english: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

paite: Diktatna lampi ka zui a, vaihawmna lampite lak ah.
english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

paite: Kei hon itte van ka luahsak theih a, agoubawm uh ka dimsak theihna ding in.
english: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

paite: Toupa'n alampi kipat tung in ahon nei a, nidang a athilhihte ma in.
english: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

paite: Tangtawn a kipan, atung a kipan leh lei om ma a pan koihkip ka hi.
english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

paite: Thuknate a-om louh lai in, lakkhiak in ka om a; luikhuk tui a dimte a-om louh lai un.
english: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

paite: Tangte a-omkip ma a, mualte om ma in lakkhiak in ka om.
english: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

paite: Lei leh gam bawlkhiak ahih ma in, leivui a khovel abawl nai louh lai in.
english: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

paite: Vante ahihkip lai in, huai ah ka om; tui thuk maikaih a tehna akoih lai in.
english: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

paite: Tung a vante abawlkip lai in; tui thukte tuikhukte ahong hat lai un.
english: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

paite: Tuipi kiang a agi apiak lai in, huchi a tuite'n athupiak tung a atatleklouhna ding un; lei suangphumte achiamteh lai in.
english: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

paite: Huai lai in akiang ah ka om, nasemmi heutu bang in; huan niteng in akipahna ka hi a, ama a kipak gige in;
english: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

paite: atentheihna lei ah; ka kipahna mite tapate kiang ah a-om hi.
english: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka tapate, hon ngaikhia unla; ka lampite zui mite'n nuam asa ngal ua.
english: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

paite: Hilhna za in pil unla, nial kei un.
english: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

paite: Mi kei hon za in nuam asa hi, niteng a ka kongpi leh ka kongkhak khuamte a ngak in.
english: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

paite: Kuapeuh hon mu in hinna amu ua, TOUPA deihsakna tang ding ahi uhi.
english: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh ka tung a thil hihkhial in amah kha ahihdik kei hi; kei hon hote'n sihna a-it uhi.
english: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
